_comment: ED-1 sweep (plans/now/difficulty.md, ED-1): a colony with empty comb and nothing to forage. energy_burn_rate 2.0 empties every bee, the queen included, in 50 s; she then lasts as long as exhaustion_health_drain allows, and her starvation collapses the run. Half a game-day is 100 s at seconds_per_day 200, so the run should end at 130-170 s. The sweep reruns this with other drains.
